name: qkd_rstseq
slot_change_request: el1013-qwen-kvcentre 10-13: NEW SLOT. qkd_pll becomes a hard macro (vendor PLL abstract, 12 pins on M8: no route); the reset sequencer ot_qwen_sys_rst_seq leaves it as this M5 leaf placed beside it. Pins: ck N (M5), por_n N; soft_rst / link_up[3:0] / boot_done[3:0] / boot_ok[3:0] W (M4); rso_c, rso_fwd, rso_{WS,WN,ES,EN}, rso_host, rso_link, boot_go[3:0] E (M4); rst_st[41:0] S (M5).

job.purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 track B: the die's reset sequencer as its own small M5 leaf beside the PLL hard macro qkd_pll (decision in el1011-qwen-tp8.log). Body ot_qwen_sys_rst_seq NL 4 (3 package SerDes ports + host SerDes) ND 4 (quadrant KV services); status inputs captured at the pins, every output a flop at its pin, reset outputs replicated per consumer (rso_c / rso_fwd = die reset, rso_<q> = HBM reset, rso_host, rso_link), boot_go x4, status word to the host. 134 flops.

benches.name: rstseq_exact
benches.note: 40,601 cycles through the leaf's own pins: cycle-exact against the body with the pin stages + order properties; 2 good boots, soft reset, link time-out (fault 1), HBM time-out (2), failed HBM check (3)

benches.name: rstseq_mutant
benches.note: OT_QKD_RSTSEQ_MUT: quadrant resets follow the die reset instead of the HBM reset
